timeline.title: Hitachi Energy profit rises; stock slipped
timeline.line: Profit rose to ₹318 crore from ₹264 crore; revenue to ₹2,996 crore from ₹1,832 crore
more: The stock fell about 1.9% despite the results
A ₹106 crore block trade also took place
